# Plan: Prevent duplicate Fragment Title for cloned cards in M@S Studio

## Summary
When a card is cloned in M@S Studio, the clone dialog pre-populates the title with the
original fragment's title, allowing two cards to share the same Fragment Title under the
same tag path. This adds a `generateUniqueTitle` utility and wires it into the clone flow
so the dialog always defaults to a deduplicated title — while still allowing manual overrides.

## Task Description
Introduce uniqueness checking for Fragment Title when a card is cloned. Before the clone
dialog opens, check whether any fragment in the current loaded list shares the same title
as the source fragment. If a conflict exists, append a numeric suffix (`-1`, `-2`, etc.)
to produce a unique default title. Uniqueness is implicitly scoped to the current tag path
because `Store.fragments.list.data` already holds only fragments matching the active search
context. Manual edits in the dialog are never blocked.

## Relevant Files

| File | Action | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| `studio/src/utils.js` | Edit | Add `generateUniqueTitle(baseTitle, existingTitles)` utility |
| `studio/src/mas-fragment-editor.js` | Edit | Call `generateUniqueTitle` in `showClone()` to pre-populate `titleClone`; bind `titleClone` in clone dialog textfield |

## Step by Step Tasks

### 1. Add `generateUniqueTitle` to `studio/src/utils.js`

- Export a new function `generateUniqueTitle(baseTitle, existingTitles)` where `existingTitles` is a `Set` or array of strings.
- If `baseTitle` is not in `existingTitles`, return it unchanged.
- Otherwise, strip any trailing `-N` numeric suffix from `baseTitle` to get the root base string (regex: `/-\d+$/`).
- Loop from `n = 1` upward, testing `${base}-${n}` until one is not in `existingTitles`.
- Return the first available candidate.

```js
export function generateUniqueTitle(baseTitle, existingTitles) {
    const titles = new Set(existingTitles);
    if (!titles.has(baseTitle)) return baseTitle;
    const base = baseTitle.replace(/-\d+$/, '');
    let n = 1;
    let candidate;
    do {
        candidate = `${base}-${n++}`;
    } while (titles.has(candidate));
    return candidate;
}
```

### 2. Import and call `generateUniqueTitle` in `showClone()` (`studio/src/mas-fragment-editor.js`)

- Import `generateUniqueTitle` from `./utils.js` at the top of the file.
- In `showClone()` (line ~1088), after the discard-changes guard, compute the list of existing titles from `Store.fragments.list.data.get()`:
  ```js
  const existingTitles = Store.fragments.list.data
      .get()
      .map((s) => s.get()?.title)
      .filter(Boolean);
  this.titleClone = generateUniqueTitle(this.fragment.title, existingTitles);
  ```
- This sets `titleClone` to a unique value before the dialog renders.
- Also reset `titleClone` in `cancelClone()` to `''` (already done at line ~1123-1128; ensure it is reset there).

### 3. Bind `titleClone` in the clone dialog textfield (`studio/src/mas-fragment-editor.js`)

- In the clone dialog render (line ~1251), change the textfield `value` attribute from:
  ```js
  value="${this.fragment.title}"
  ```
  to:
  ```js
  value="${this.titleClone}"
  ```
- This ensures the dialog opens showing the deduplicated title. User can still type a different title, which updates `titleClone` via the existing `updateCloneFragmentInternal` handler.

### 4. Pass `titleClone` correctly in `confirmClone()` (`studio/src/mas-fragment-editor.js`)

- `confirmClone()` already calls `this.repository.copyFragment(this.titleClone, ...)`.
- With `titleClone` now always set in `showClone()`, the title passed to `copyFragment` will be the unique (or manually edited) title.
- No change needed in `copyFragment` itself.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Cloning a card whose title already exists in the current list produces a default dialog title with `-1` suffix
- Cloning again produces `-2`, `-3`, etc. in sequence
- The original card's title is unchanged after any clone operation
- If the user manually types a custom title in the clone dialog, that custom value is used verbatim (no auto-dedup on manual edits)
- Uniqueness check is based on fragments already loaded in `Store.fragments.list.data` (same tag path scope)
- No two cards in the current list share the same Fragment Title after a clone operation

## Validation Commands
- `node --check studio/src/utils.js`
- `node --check studio/src/mas-fragment-editor.js`
